name: baileys-sidecar
description: Supply-chain release gate for the Baileys sidecar (FUL-20 / FUL-23). The actual sidecar application source lands under this directory; this manifest carries the zero-dependency supply-chain gate (osv-gate.mjs) and its self-test so the merge-blocking CI check (baileys-sidecar-ci / baileys-sidecar-gate) runs green from day one.
